div.div:
setEveryRedstoneIO(0) // In case anything is on
os.sleep(50) // Might be needed to avoid CPU Starvation Problems
reactors = getConnectedReactors()
lsc = getConnectedLSC()
interface.updateLSCStatus(lsc.status)
interface.updateReactorsStatus
while shouldRun do
lsc.tick()
tickReactors()
interface.update(lsc.status. reactors)
end
